Choose the brand accent

This page shows each of the 8 candidate accent colours on the same small product view, in the light and the dark theme side by side. Under each view are its lowest contrast ratio and how close it sits to a status colour, so a choice can weigh appearance against those limits. The current default, Indigo, is provisional; nothing here has been decided.

The page itself uses the neutral slate accent so its own links do not favour a candidate. Each sample is a separate document with its own theme, so it looks the same whichever theme your system uses.

Minimum ratio is the lowest across both themes among the declared contrast pairs that use an accent role. Hue gap is measured from the accent to the status hue in the same theme.
